pairs_explained: Every 15-to-16-second pair is one run of the S_00 silver-prep stage, not two schedules. build_canonical_prices_v2.py puts the table with upload_file at :660, then auto-chains inject_scoped_overrides.py --upload (build :670, subprocess :506), whose save puts the table again at inject :253. The S_00 telemetry windows cover both puts: 2026-10-13T04:01:22Z to 04:03:44Z (puts 04:03:26Z and 04:03:42Z), 2026-10-13T12:45:52Z to 12:48:08Z (puts 12:47:50Z and 12:48:05Z), 2026-10-12T00:18:44Z to 00:21:03Z (puts 00:20:45Z and 00:21:01Z). The second put is the larger object, consistent with the appended override rows. The single versions at about 00:15 to 00:24 each day are bd-price-update (row 1) and carry no pair. Which trigger starts each S_00 run is partly explained: the 04:0x and 23:0x runs follow bd-gold-trigger REPORT lines at 04:00:46Z and 23:00:11Z (matched by time); the 00:xx S3-event start produced an S_00 run on 10-12 only; the 09:4x and 12:4x runs have no attributed trigger in the reads above (see the surprise rows).
